name: Kitami Honoka
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c62812]Rin Hoshina[/url]'s roommate, and also a student at the all-girls school he attends.

She has feelings for him, but is hesitant to start a romantic relationship.

[spoiler]This is because she has a memory disorder and is worried about forgetting him.[/spoiler]
translation:
[url=https://vndb.org/c62812]Rin Hoshina[/url]'s roommate, and also a student at the all-girls school he attends.
